# Failed Compile Handling

If an exception occurs during the compilation process, it will rollback any changes made in the session, set the compile status to 'failed', and raise a CompileError to signal the failure. This risk affects the reliability of the whole compilation process.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._compile_one`

- [knowledge_compiler.compiler.run](../component/knowledge-compiler-compiler-run.md)
